lines.text: The writer urges Euodia and Syntyche to agree in the Lord and asks a true yokefellow to help them.
These women contended at the writer's side for the gospel, along with Timothy and the other fellow workers.
They are told to rejoice in the Lord always and let their gentleness be apparent to all.
They should be anxious for nothing, present requests to God, and God's peace will guard their hearts and minds.
Whatever they learned or saw in the writer, they must practice, and the God of Abraham will be with them.
